description: Create a new idea on the workspace's idea board, optionally seeded with an initial body or topic.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

initial_body.description:
Optional starter text. Stored as the idea's first timeline entry so
the editor opens with something to build on.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

seed_topic.description:
Originating prompt or trending-topic seed text. When supplied without
an `initial_body`, this text seeds the idea's first entry.

title.description: Optional human title for the idea card.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in. Do not ask the user for this UUID — call aidelly_list_workspaces and use the `id` of the matching workspace. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_create_idea
